info.title: UK PostcodeKit - Postcode Lookup, Nearest, Autocomplete & Distance
info.description:
# UK PostcodeKit: Postcode Lookup, Nearest, Autocomplete and Distance

Fast UK postcode data for Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales): coordinates, county, district and ward with ONS codes, validation, type-ahead autocomplete, nearest-postcode search and distances. Served from a local copy of Ordnance Survey Code-Point Open, so responses take milliseconds.

**Who it's for:** UK e-commerce checkouts, delivery and logistics, property and local-services apps, store locators, councils and data teams.

## Use cases
- Validate and format postcodes in checkout and signup forms.
- Power postcode type-ahead in address forms.
- Find stores, branches or tradespeople nearest a customer's postcode.
- Quote delivery zones from postcode-to-postcode distance.
- Enrich customer records with district, ward and ONS codes for reporting.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://uk-postcodekit-postcode-lookup-nearest-distance.p.rapidapi.com/lookup?postcode=SW1A%201AA' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: uk-postcodekit-postcode-lookup-nearest-distance.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`uk-postcodekit-postcode-lookup-nearest-distance.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Coverage is Great Britain. Northern Ireland and Channel Islands/Isle of Man postcodes are not included and return 404 on lookup.
- Coordinates are postcode centroids (WGS84). Distances are straight-line, not routes.
- Responses that carry OS data include an `attribution` field; the Open Government Licence requires you to show it.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `404` not found, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `503` temporarily unavailable, retry shortly. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right 2026. Source: Ordnance Survey Code-Point Open, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/).

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Returns coordinates, positional quality, country, county, district, ward and their ONS codes for a postcode in Great Britain.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode, any case, with or without the space.

example.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right 2026. Licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

404.description: Postcode not found (terminated, or outside Great Britain).

example.error: Postcode not found (it may be terminated, or a Northern Ireland/Channel Islands postcode not covered)

422.description: Not a valid UK postcode format.

example.error: Not a valid UK postcode format

get.description: Checks the postcode format and whether it exists in the current database, and returns the normalised form. Never errors on bad input: check `valid_format` and `exists`.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode, any case, with or without the space.

get.description: Finds postcodes within a radius of a postcode or a latitude/longitude, nearest first, with distances in metres. Give `postcode`, or both `lat` and `lng`.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Centre postcode. Takes priority over lat/lng.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Centre latitude (WGS84), used when no postcode is given. Great Britain spans roughly 49.9 to 60.9.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Centre longitude (WGS84), used when no postcode is given. Great Britain spans roughly -8.7 to 1.8.

example.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right 2026. Licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

example.error: Postcode not found (it may be terminated, or a Northern Ireland/Channel Islands postcode not covered)

422.description: Neither a postcode nor lat and lng, or a non-integer radius/limit.

example.error: postcode, or lat and lng, is required

get.description: Returns postcodes that start with the characters typed so far (spaces ignored), in alphabetical order. Built for address-form type-ahead.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial postcode, at least 2 letters/digits (spaces ignored). `postcode` is accepted as an alias.

422.description: q shorter than 2 characters or contains invalid characters.

example.error: q must be at least 2 characters of a postcode

get.description: Straight-line (great-circle) distance between two postcodes in kilometres and miles. Not a driving distance.

404.description: Postcode not found (terminated, or outside Great Britain).

example.error: Postcode not found (it may be terminated, or a Northern Ireland/Channel Islands postcode not covered)

422.description: Not a valid UK postcode format.

example.error: Not a valid UK postcode format

get.description: For an outward code such as BS3 or SW1A, returns the number of postcodes with coordinates, the centroid and the local authority districts it covers.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Outward code (the part before the space), e.g. BS3, SW1A, M1.

example.attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains Royal Mail data © Royal Mail copyright and database right 2026. Licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

example.error: outcode must look like BS3 or SW1A

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

positional_quality.description: Code-Point Open positional quality: 10 = within a building at the postcode (best), 20-50 = progressively approximate, 60 = postcode-sector mean, 90 = no coordinates.

county.description: County (null for unitary authorities and London boroughs).

district.description: Local authority district or unitary authority.

district_code.description: ONS GSS code of the district, e.g. E09000033.

ward_code.description: ONS GSS code of the ward, e.g. E05013806.

attribution.description: Required OGL v3 attribution for OS and Royal Mail data. Display it where you show the data.

exists.description: Present in the current database (live, Great Britain).

normalized.description: Formatted postcode, or null if the format is invalid.

results.description: Postcodes within the radius, nearest first.
